## numbers

| h | Hebbian | Trained (Adam, cross-entropy) |
|---|---|---|
| 32 | 109 (60–150) | 1071 (1037–1106) |
| 64 | 134 (102–152) | 2336 (2320–2350) |
| 128 | 636 (534–706) | 5002 (4950–5040) |
| 256 | 1155 (1068–1282) | 10284 (10168–10422) |
| 512 | 2282 (1821–2532) | 20901 (20797–20965) |
| 1024 | 5118 (4175–5897) | 41840 (40732–42394) |
| 2048 | 10664 (10332–10883) | 84473 (83728–84883) |

* Hebbian: capacity ≈ 1.78 · h^1.149 (r² = 0.9815) over all h
  * top three h only: capacity ≈ 2.24 · h^1.112, i.e. 5.2 contexts per dimension (0.020 per parameter)
* Trained (Adam, cross-entropy): capacity ≈ 30.03 · h^1.046 (r² = 0.9995) over all h
  * top three h only: capacity ≈ 38.91 · h^1.007, i.e. 41.2 contexts per dimension (0.161 per parameter)
